preconditions.description: The input integer x must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (len(stdout.strip().split()) == 2 and all(1 <= int(num) <= int(stdin.strip()) for num in stdout.strip().split()))
postconditions.description: The output must be either '-1' or two integers a and b, each between 1 and x inclusive.
If the output is not '-1', then b must divide a without a remainder.
If the output is not '-1', then the product of a and b must be greater than x.
If the output is not '-1', then the quotient of a divided by b must be less than x.
